ownerAuthorization: Operator 2026-11-05 (cloud session): grants the cloud agent ORCHESTRATOR to coordinate the design and admission for physical-relaunch prevention that the R139 causal assessment names as the reopen prerequisite; approved one read-only npm tarball fetch for source verification; requires a separate branch and a PR per tranche; merge to main is reserved to the Local agent after its own review.
scope: DESIGN/SPEC only: identify a source-backed native primitive that prevents physical Chrome relaunch before action, bind it into a successor integrated-lifecycle contract proposal, and obtain an independent design review. No implementation, no runtime, no reopen of the R139 repair audit (Local decides reopen).
verification: Byte-identity of the public package against the 15 native source hashes already recorded from the operator's Windows install; static source citations with file:line; independent design review. Unverified Chrome-side behaviour is recorded as an explicit assumption for a later separately admitted check.
claimBoundary: Static source and design evidence only. No native process, browser, DB, provider, runtime CVF governance, M3-05/M3-08, R139 or product acceptance.
